publisher_domain.description: The canonical domain of the publisher being audited (e.g. 'example.com').

ads_txt_entries.description: List of entries parsed from the publisher's ads.txt file.

ssp.description: Name of the SSP / ad exchange (e.g. 'AppNexus').

pub_id.description: Publisher account ID as declared in ads.txt.

relationship.description: Relationship type from the ads.txt entry.

sellers_json_records.description: List of seller records fetched from the SSP's sellers.json file.

ssp.description: Name of the SSP / ad exchange matching ads_txt_entries.ssp.

seller_id.description: Seller identifier as declared in sellers.json.

domain.description: Domain associated with this seller in sellers.json.

is_confidential.description: 1 if the seller has requested confidentiality (transparency violation); 0 otherwise.
